In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], a '''Quara Aqualish''' was employed as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to [[Big Bunji/Legends|Big Bunji]], the owner and operator of the [[Jubilee Wheel (space station)|''Jubilee Wheel'']] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] over [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. When the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Roa]] were aboard, this [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] escorted the two of them, as well as the hoodlum [[Fasgo]], to see Bunji, who was an old acquaintance of Solo's. Bunji and his lieutenant fled when the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], invaders from beyond [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Battle of Ord Mantell (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] the ''Wheel'', and the lieutenant located Solo shortly after at a bar in the [[Lady Fate Casino/Legends|Lady Fate Casino]] on Ord Mantell's surface. Bunji felt remorse for leaving his guests behind on the ''Wheel'', and as such, the lieutenant passed on to Solo information of Bunji's regarding [[Reck Desh]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] that Solo was pursuing.<ref name="ht" />
